problem.title: How can I optimize my Python code so the runtime would be faster?
problem.description: My Python script is separated into different files, each one queries an API for data, analyzes the data, and writes text to a PowerPoint and an Excel file. Since there's is a lot of data, and at least 7 files going through the PowerPoint and Excel, the script is pretty slow. I can't make the functions async since they are all reading/writing in the PowerPoint/Excel files.
